# Decision Circuits

> Open-weights models that answer a typed question with a calibrated probability, plus a Python library that turns those probabilities into decisions in code. Built so software — and agents — can tell a 0.95 from a 0.55 and escalate to a human when a number sits too close to a threshold to call.

If you are an agent and want to use this in your own work, start with the skill: it covers getting a free API key and wiring a calibrated judgment into a decision.

## For agents
- [Agent skill](https://decisioncircuits.com/skill.md): when to reach for a calibrated judgment, how to get a key, how to threshold the result. Written to be dropped straight into an agent's skills directory.
- API: `POST https://api.decisioncircuits.com/v1/keys` for a free key, `POST https://api.decisioncircuits.com/v1/systemone` to ask. 60 questions a minute, no account, no card.

## Docs
- [Site](https://decisioncircuits.com): live demo, scoreboard, and a benchmark quiz
- [Concepts](https://github.com/Barneyjm/decision-circuits/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): state, questions, answers, gates, uncertainty
- [Integrations](https://github.com/Barneyjm/decision-circuits/blob/main/docs/integrations.md): LangChain, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK
- [Extending](https://github.com/Barneyjm/decision-circuits/blob/main/docs/extending.md): writing your own backend or gate

## Code and weights
- [decision-circuits on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/decision-circuits/): `pip install decision-circuits`, zero dependencies
- [SDK source](https://github.com/Barneyjm/decision-circuits)
- [Model weights](https://huggingface.co/jbarney): circuit-1.7b, circuit-8b, circuit-vl-4b, circuit-audio-7b — Apache 2.0, run them yourself
- [Training and evaluation harness](https://github.com/Barneyjm/circuit): every benchmark number with its method
